rows.name: traction
rows.description: Transmitted traction = linker_occupancy x cortex_tension; the occupancy-gated force passed to the BM.

rows.name: linker_occupancy
rows.description: Fraction of bound basal linkers in [0, 1]; first-order on/off kinetics.

rows.name: bm_strain_rate
rows.description: BM strain rate = coupling_gain x traction; the deformation the transmitted traction drives.

rows.name: bm_sigma
rows.description: In-plane stress of the collagen IV BM patch (sigma_inplane) under the transmitted load; the BM's mechanical response.

rows.name: cortex_tension
rows.description: Active cortical tension from the E1 actomyosin cortex that the linkers pull on.
